title: fix: quest leaderboard counts every quest reward except BYOP and BYOM
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The Community quest leaderboard now counts rewards from quest issues, merged PRs, reported issues, censuses, app listings, setup, usage, top-ups, profile and Discord quests, and admin grants. It excludes only BYOP app-growth and BYOM model/agent rewards, using quest IDs exported from those groups. Previously it counted only GitHub quest-issue bounties: 42 participants, 164 rewards and 1,204 Pollen. A read-only production check with the wider scope found 39,382 participants, 72,751 rewards and 45,267 Pollen; tomdacatto led with 540.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel garden, Polli wears a tiny bookkeeper's visor and updates a lime green (#ecf874) quest leaderboard beside blooming code-plants, with two small BYOP and BYOM baskets set aside. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream and lavender tones and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
